headline: Early Election Counts Show South Africa's ANC Losing Lead in Johannesburg
summary: Preliminary election vote tallies indicate the Democratic Alliance leading in Johannesburg and ActionSA leading in Tshwane, with the ruling ANC trailing in both major cities.
why: Johannesburg and Tshwane form South Africa's primary economic hub; local political outcomes influence municipal service delivery, infrastructure, and fiscal spending.

impacts.name: South Africa
impacts.why: Loss of electoral control in major commercial metros increases municipal governance uncertainty.
